stem.text: An indicator is colourless in acid and pink in alkali.
In an experiment a petri dish of agar was prepared using an acidic solution of this indicator.
A disc of agar $1\,\text{cm}$ in diameter was removed from the centre to create a well.
A white card showing circular marker lines $1\,\text{cm}$ apart was placed underneath the petri dish.
$1\,\text{cm}^{3}$ alkali solution was put into the well in the agar and a stop-watch was started.

A circular disc of pink colour appeared and spread through the agar. It reached the first marker line in a short time but took longer to reach the second marker line and a very long time to reach the third marker line.
